newsitem.title: JAPAN: Idemitsu to cut July wholesale oil product prices.
newsitem.headline: Idemitsu to cut July wholesale oil product prices.

text.p: Major refiner Idemitsu Kosan Co Ltd said on Friday it would lower its wholesale oil product prices by 0.2 yen per litre effective July 1.
Following the change gasoline will be priced at 89.5 yen per litre, including tax, Idemitsu said in a news release.
Gas oil and kerosene will be priced at 35.5 yen per litre.
Japan's major oil companies review their wholesale product prices on a monthly basis, taking into account international crude prices as well as fluctuations in the currency market.
Idemitsu said that the rise in the yen's strength against the dollar offset higher crude oil prices.
